question: How is the manifest-unmanifest form characterized by a manifest mark identified?
premises: A form is described as both manifest and unmanifest.
This form is recognized as possessing a manifest mark.
The description of this form is now being presented.
inference: The manifest-unmanifest form is identified as that which bears a manifest mark.
plain_english: This manifest-unmanifest form is known as having a manifest mark; now it is being described.
